candidates.meaning: List all drugs that are classified as analgesics, along with their effects and manufacturers, including any prescriptions that are for analgesics.
candidates.sql: SELECT m.Name, m.Effectiveness, m.Manufacturer, p.Quantity FROM Medications m JOIN Prescriptions p ON m.MedicationID = p.MedicationID WHERE m.Classification = 'Analgesic'

candidates.meaning: List all drugs that are classified as analgesics, along with their effects and manufacturers, and any associated diagnoses or appointments.
candidates.sql: SELECT m.Name, m.Effectiveness, m.Manufacturer, d.Description, a.ReasonForVisit FROM Medications m LEFT JOIN Prescriptions p ON m.MedicationID = p.MedicationID LEFT JOIN Diagnoses d ON p.PatientID = d.PatientID LEFT JOIN Appointments a ON p.PatientID = a.PatientID WHERE m.Classification = 'Analgesic'
